benchmarks.title: Held-out advisories (v2.1)
benchmarks.description: 17 published advisories in open-source Python web projects, chosen after the SQL-injection reviewer was written and run once, not tuned on. Each introducing PR is paired with its fix as a control.

benchmarks.title: Development advisories (v2.0)
benchmarks.description: 13 merged pull requests that introduced a vulnerability later published as an advisory (4 SQL injection, 9 authorization), each with its fix as a control.

benchmarks.title: Shoply synthetic PRs
benchmarks.description: 52 small PRs to a Flask shop app: half add a SQL injection or authorization bug, half are safe controls.
